newsitem.title: USA: Tandy Corp may issue $200 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Tandy Corp may issue $200 mln in debt.

text.p: Tandy Corp is expected to tap the corporate bond primary market with a $200 million debt offering as early as this week, syndicate sources said on Tuesday.
The deal, which includes a 10-year maturity, will be underwitten by lead manager Bear Stearns & Co, sources said.
Last week, the Texas-based consumer electronics and computer retailer, filed a shelf offering for up to $300 million in debt securities with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Procceds from the offering will be used to reduce short-term debt, the company said.
